truth_anchors: User screenshots: OmniMind closed/open Environment and Codex continuously resized states
preserve_capabilities: Agent and Chat remain the only primary work modes
Timeline and Composer share one stable conversation column
Environment keeps repository, branch, recap, source, and notepad information
RightDock keeps Files, Diff, Terminal, Browser, Device, and mounted pane state
PlanSidebar keeps its current task, proposed plan, per-turn dismiss, and handoff intent without becoming a new responsive owner
Manual close preferences survive automatic responsive suppression
Streaming, scroll position, draft text, attachments, focus, and pane state survive layout changes
Simplified Chinese and English remain complete product paths
allowed_rewrites: Remove Environment's fixed 312px content inset and docked presentation
Make left navigation presentation responsive to actual available width
Switch RightDock from split to single-panel presentation at constrained widths
Replace fixed-width auxiliary presentation with floating or sheet presentation
Introduce local presentation-tier derivation by ResizeObserver without new persistent state
forbidden_changes: No production code changes before explicit storyboard approval
No new global layout store, database, migration, registry, or responsive control plane
Do not lower the Desktop minimum width before whole-app 480px verification
Do not replace existing Sidebar, Sheet, RightDock, or Composer state owners
Do not copy Codex visual branding
